purpose: Record current truth-sensitive invariants, including exact-head workflow authority. Required PR verification must execute against the immutable pull-request head, not GitHub's synthetic merge ref; migration lint must start its local Supabase dependency and fail closed on real lint failure. These workflow facts do not authorize merge, deployment, database mutation, terminal execution, publication, commerce, or any other separately gated action.

claims: .github/workflows/quality-gate.yml: every required pull-request Quality Gate job must check out EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA, immediately verify git HEAD equals that immutable SHA, and reject synthetic merge-ref substitution; Migration Lint must start the pinned local Supabase stack before running supabase db lint --local, remain load-bearing for Production Build, and stop the local stack in cleanup without converting a real lint failure into advisory success.

.github/workflows/cloudflare-build-diagnostic.yml: the exact-current-main Worker Git authority audit must require the dedicated read-only Workers Builds user token for its primary provider readback; request-trace and DNS-inventory remain optional evidence lanes, and whether they are missing, malformed, or provider-rejected they may retain their own bounded evidence/error but cannot downgrade or upgrade the snapshotted core authority ok/error verdict; absence of a core receipt must never manufacture authority, and the workflow remains read-only and cannot authorize provider mutation.

.github/workflows/n8n-runtime-integration-proof.yml: CI-only n8n runtime proof must mask generated bearer and encryption credentials before exporting them to later steps, while keeping the runtime ephemeral and non-production-authorizing.

src/http/routes/n8nConveyor.ts: founder-authenticated conveyor readiness must resolve retained activation proof against the deployed exact GIT_SHA and must fail closed instead of claiming live verification when proof is missing, stale, or unreadable.

wrangler.worker.toml: every canonical Worker build must execute the repository build-authority membrane; native Cloudflare Workers Builds may proceed only through non-promoting versions upload while production promotion remains bounded to the exact manual GitHub authority path.

src/http/routes/n8nConveyor.ts: authenticated conveyor readiness must resolve retained activation proof at request time and may report live only when the persisted activation receipt is bound to the deployed exact GIT_SHA; stale, missing, or unreadable proof must remain non-live, and no credential value may be exposed.
